head: Meshy AI turns photos and text into 3D models to print
dek: Meshy AI makes a textured 3D model, ready for 3D printing, from a photo, a sketch or a text description, without desktop software. It was #95 in Graphics & Design among free apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: The listing says over 10 million creators use Meshy. It's made by Meshy LLC and is free with in-app purchases.
means: If you have a 3D printer, you can turn a photo or an idea into a printable model on your phone.
todo: Download Meshy AI and check what the in-app purchases include before you start.
